change_summary: Material in-season sensing update under seasonal policy v2.1. The 17:06:04 CDT synchronized capture identity matched status, burst and vision, but pcl_e2_back_deck failed and produced no valid burst; Point Clear owner-camera coverage is 2/3 while Montrose remains 3/3. The other five three-frame bursts had fair-to-good visibility and moderate-to-high detectability with no visible Jubilee-related biological or human signal in their scoped areas. Direct Grand Hotel and Fairhope live-player checks used two isolated samples 25.678 seconds apart at 17:29–17:30 CDT. Both playback positions and rolling endpoints advanced with visible scene progression. Fairhope's Seek to live control was used, but the player still reported behind live, so exact delay remains unknown; low-sun glare limited biology and neither Fairhope beach is visible. Fresh NGOFS2 model guidance reversed to seaward transport across 1–12 hours after a modestly shoreward antecedent nowcast. Direct local bottom oxygen and observed nearshore transport remain UNKNOWN; no credible September 8 first-person Jubilee report was found.
